_note: v2.4 plan 02 follow-up E4 live gate (00-overview Decisions E4; 02 gate record 'Follow-ups E2-E5' NOT done list). No model call. Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes 2 --repeat 2 --strict --group 1759606632088 test/scenarios/live-v24-02-e4-mirror-marker.json. Chat B (a second sandbox chat) plays one consumed line with a relationship memory, so the mirror makes B's book and T14 adoption marks it; the fixture then strips the so-owner entry from the book on the server, which is exactly a book mirrored before T14 that B's extras.memory.wiBook still names. Two control books are created unmarked: the story's mirror name with chat A's id (another chat's suffix) and another title with chat B's id (an unrecorded book). One syncWorldInfo in B must write a disabled, keyless so-owner entry naming chat B into B's book and leave both controls unmarked (E4: marked only on exact name for THIS chat and wiBook naming it). Then chat B is deleted from chat A (deleteGroupChat): the reap must be offered for B's book within 8 s; the fixture declines it, the same answer the runners' settleReapPrompts gives, and the book must still exist (a reap is never automatic). The control books are deleted by the fixture; B's book by the sandbox mirror-book cleanup.

requires.why: the mirror's relationship fact is planted through a mocked read the transcript does not support; judge memoryVerify (on by default since v2.6 rule 5) drops it on a judge-on lane, the mirror then skips as nothing-live (memoryMirror.ts mirroredEntries, 01 diagnosis) and the book half has nothing to check; the subject is the mirror, not the judge (green x2 on the judge-off no-model lane, T7 SUITE)

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); globalThis.__e4.chatB = ctx.chatId; if (ctx.chatId === globalThis.__e4.chatA) throw new Error('/newchat did not move to a new chat'); return { greetingsCleared: greetings, chatId: ctx.chatId };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = globalThis.__e4; const summary = await rt.syncWorldInfo(); if (rt.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook?.name !== state.book) throw new Error(`the sync re-adopted another book: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook)}`); const data = await state.serverBook(state.book); const marks = state.markers(data); if (marks.length !== 1) throw new Error(`E4: after one sync the pre-T14 book holds ${marks.length} so-owner entries, expected 1`); const mark = marks[0]; const owner = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(mark.content); } catch { return null; } })(); if (owner?.chatId !== state.chatB) throw new Error(`E4: the marker does not name chat B: ${mark.content}`); if (mark.disable !== true) throw new Error(`E4: the marker entry is not disabled: ${JSON.stringify({ disable: mark.disable })}`); if ((mark.key ?? []).length || (mark.keysecondary ?? []).length) throw new Error(`E4: the marker entry has keys: ${JSON.stringify({ key: mark.key, keysecondary: mark.keysecondary })}`); const controls = []; for (const name of state.controls) { const control = await state.serverBook(name); if (!control) throw new Error(`control book ${name} is gone`); controls.push({ name, markers: state.markers(control).length }); } const marked = controls.filter((entry) => entry.markers); if (marked.length) throw new Error(`E4: a control book was marked: ${JSON.stringify(marked)}`); return { summary, marker: owner, controls };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); await ctx.openGroupChat(ctx.groupId, globalThis.__e4.chatA); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && SillyTavern.getContext().chatId !== globalThis.__e4.chatA; i += 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); if (SillyTavern.getContext().chatId !== globalThis.__e4.chatA) throw new Error('could not return to chat A'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); return { on: SillyTavern.getContext().chatId };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const { chatB, book } = globalThis.__e4; const { deleteGroupChat } = await import('/scripts/group-chats.js'); await deleteGroupChat(ctx.groupId, chatB, { jumpToNewChat: false }); const data = await fetch('/api/chats/group/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id: chatB }) }).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null); if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length) throw new Error('chat B is still on disk after deleteGroupChat'); const offered = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open] .popup-content')].map((node) => node.textContent ??
